content: {"like": ["Technology advanced, allowing the team to use electronic devices that did not exist previously to improve the visual effects of the series.", "Peter Graves had an emotional attachment to the characters, giving the team a vested interest in being successful that did not exist during the original seasons.", "The fresh faces made the team realistic, reflecting that agents who successfully complete Impossible Missions cannot live forever."], "dislike": ["Most of the storylines were repeats from previous seasons, partly due to the writer's strike of 1988.", "The new cast members were not better than the original cast (Leonard Nimoy, Martin Landau, Barbara Bain, Greg Morris, Peter Lupus).", "Peter Graves was too old to be a believable and effective field agent, and his mistakes were more frequent than the original cast, leading to a sense of let‑down."]}
